q: 这个 Web Crawler 题的核心目标最准确地说是什么？
options: 从种子 URL 出发抓取网页、抽取文本并保存给后续训练使用
实时渲染所有 JavaScript 页面并抓取图片视频
为网站管理员提供可视化爬虫管理后台
构建一个能搜索和排序网页的完整搜索引擎
why: 目标收敛到为 LLM 训练收集网页文本，而不是做搜索排名、动态渲染或非文本处理。面试重点是抓取、抽取、存储和扩展。
why_en: The design is scoped to crawl from seed URLs, extract page text, and store it for later LLM training rather than building a full search engine.
scenario: 面试官要求设计一个为 LLM 训练收集网页文本的抓取系统（类似 OpenAI/Google 的训练数据管线），而不是搜索引擎或问答产品。
options_en: Crawl from seed URLs, extract page text, and store it for later training.
Render every page's JavaScript live and capture images and video.
Give website admins a dashboard to manage crawler behavior.
Build a full search engine that indexes and ranks web pages.
q_en: What is the core goal of this web crawler design?
scenario_en: The interviewer asks for a crawler that collects web text for LLM training, like an OpenAI or Google training-data pipeline, not a search engine or QA product.
optionExplanations: 这正是本题范围：抓取网页、抽文本、存起来供 LLM 训练用。
渲染 JS 和抓图片视频属于另一类爬虫，这道题不做实时渲染。
管理后台是运维工具，不是要设计的抓取、抽取、存储主链路。
搜索引擎还要做排序和查询服务，这道题只到产出训练文本为止。
optionExplanations_en: This is exactly the scope: crawl pages, extract text, and store it for LLM training.
Rendering JS live and pulling images or video belongs to a different crawler, not this text-only design.
An admin dashboard is an ops tool, not part of the crawl/extract/store pipeline in question.
A search engine also needs ranking and query serving; this design stops at producing training text.

q: Web Crawler 的核心功能需求包括哪些？（多选）
options: 从给定种子 URL 开始遍历网页
抽取每个网页的文本并存储
训练最终的大语言模型
处理登录后才能看到的页面
why: 本题只覆盖抓取和文本落库；训练模型、鉴权页面、动态内容、图片视频都被放到范围外。先明确范围能防止设计发散。
why_en: The core functions are crawling from seed URLs and storing extracted text, while model training and authenticated or dynamic content are out of scope.
options_en: Traverse the web starting from given seed URLs.
Extract each page's text and store it.
Train the final large language model.
Handle pages that require logging in.
q_en: Which functions are core requirements for this web crawler? (Select all that apply)
optionExplanations: 这条确立了系统入口：从种子集合出发做广度遍历，覆盖新链接。
这是系统唯一的产出动作：把网页转成文本，落到存储供后续读取。
训练模型是下游消费方的工作，这道题只交付文本，不训练模型。
登录态页面需要额外鉴权和会话管理，这道题范围只覆盖公开静态页面。
optionExplanations_en: This defines the entry point: traverse the web breadth-first from the seed set.
This is the crawler's only output action: turn pages into text and persist it for later reads.
Training the model is a downstream consumer's job; this design only delivers text.
Login-gated pages need extra auth and session handling, outside this crawler's public-page scope.

scenario: 这个爬虫的主线是收集公开静态网页文本，供后续 LLM 训练数据管线使用。
scenario_en: This crawler is scoped to collect public static web text for a later LLM training-data pipeline.
q: 这个 LLM 文本爬虫明确放到范围外的事项有哪些？（多选）
options: 处理非文本数据，如图片和视频
处理 JavaScript 渲染出的动态内容
处理需要登录的页面
记录每个 URL 的抓取状态
why: 非文本、动态内容、认证页面都不在核心设计里；URL 状态记录反而是后续容错和去重需要的内部状态。范围外不代表不能扩展，只是主线不展开。
why_en: Non-text media, JavaScript-rendered content, and authenticated pages are explicitly out of scope, while URL state tracking remains part of the crawler design.
options_en: Handling non-text data such as images and video.
Handling dynamic content rendered by JavaScript.
Handling pages that require a login.
Tracking each URL's crawl status.
q_en: Which items are explicitly out of scope for this LLM text crawler? (Select all that apply)
optionExplanations: 图片视频属于非文本媒体，这条 LLM 文本管线不处理，只处理可抽取的文本。
JS 渲染出的动态内容需要额外的浏览器执行环境，主线只抓静态 HTML。
登录页面需要维护会话和凭证，这条主线只覆盖公开可抓的页面。
URL 抓取状态是内部去重和容错必需的元数据，反而要保留，不是被排除的功能。
optionExplanations_en: Images and video are non-text media this LLM text pipeline never processes.
JS-rendered dynamic content needs a browser execution environment; the main line only fetches static HTML.
Login-gated pages require session and credential handling, outside this public-page pipeline.
URL crawl-state tracking is internal metadata needed for dedup and fault tolerance, so it stays in scope.

q: 这个 LLM 文本爬虫的核心非功能需求包括哪些？（多选）
options: 故障后能恢复且不丢进度
遵守 robots.txt 并避免压垮站点
5 天内完成大规模抓取
强一致地更新网页排名
why: 非功能主线是容错、礼貌、效率和可扩展到 10B 页面；网页排名不在这个 LLM 文本抓取题的主目标里。后续深挖都围绕这些约束展开。
why_en: The important nonfunctional requirements are fault tolerance, politeness, five-day completion, and scale to ten billion pages.
scenario: 该系统要为 LLM 训练抓取约 10B 网页文本，业务方要求 5 天内可用，并且不能对被抓取网站造成过大压力。
options_en: Recover from failures without losing progress.
Respect robots.txt and avoid overloading sites.
Finish the large-scale crawl within five days.
Keep page-rank scores strongly consistent.
q_en: Which nonfunctional requirements matter most for this LLM text crawler? (Select all that apply)
scenario_en: The crawler needs to collect about 10 billion web pages for LLM training within five days without overloading the sites it visits.
optionExplanations: 抓取要跑很久，Worker 崩溃是常态；这条要求保证进度不会归零。
礼貌抓取避免把目标站点打垮，也是不被封禁的前提。
5 天完成 10B 页面是硬性时间预算，直接决定后面要并行多少台机器。
网页排名一致性是搜索引擎才关心的问题，这道 LLM 文本抓取题不做排名。
optionExplanations_en: The crawl runs for days and workers will crash, so this guarantees progress survives failures.
Polite crawling keeps target sites from being overwhelmed, and keeps the crawler from getting blocked.
Finishing 10B pages in five days is a hard time budget that drives the fleet-size math later.
Page-rank consistency is a search engine's concern; this crawl never computes rankings.

q: 这组体量假设最直接决定了后续设计的哪个环节？
options: 决定了 Metadata DB 该选关系型还是文档型
决定了需要多少台抓取机器和总带宽预算
决定了要不要给每个域名设置速率限制
决定了文本抽取该用哪种 NLP 模型
why: 10B 页面和 2MB/页是后续带宽和机器数估算的输入锚点，不是要背的孤立数字。
why_en: The page count and average page size are the anchor inputs for bandwidth and fleet-size math, not facts to memorize on their own.
scenario: 面试官给出规模假设：网页总量约 10B，平均每页传输体量约 2MB（HTML 本身更小，但要给内联资源和规划余量）。
options_en: It determines whether the metadata store should be relational or document-based.
It determines how much bandwidth and how many crawler machines you need.
It determines whether to rate-limit each domain.
It determines which NLP model to use for text extraction.
q_en: Which later design decision is most directly driven by these scale assumptions?
scenario_en: The interviewer gives a scale assumption: about 10 billion pages, with roughly 2 MB transferred per page to leave room for embedded resources and planning margin.
optionExplanations: 数据库选型看的是查询模式和一致性需求，不是页面总量或单页体量。
页面数乘单页体量换算成总传输量，是估算机器数和带宽预算的输入。
域名限速取决于礼貌策略，不取决于总页面数或单页大小。
NLP 模型选择看内容语言和抽取质量要求，跟这组体量数字无关。
optionExplanations_en: Database choice hinges on query patterns and consistency needs, not total page count or size.
Page count times average page size converts into total transfer volume, the input to fleet sizing.
Per-domain rate limiting comes from politeness policy, not from total page count or size.
NLP model choice depends on content language and extraction quality, unrelated to these scale numbers.

q: 补全这个数据处理系统的输入和输出：
text: 输入是{{种子 URL}}；输出是从网页中抽取并保存的{{文本数据}}。
why: 非用户交互系统先定义边界很有用：系统接收什么、产出什么。这里边界非常清楚，后续组件只是在这条数据流上扩展。
why_en: For this data-processing system, the input is seed URLs and the output is extracted text data stored for later use.
q_en: Fill in the input and output of this data-processing system:

q: 把基础 Web Crawler 的数据流排成正确顺序。
steps: 抽取文本并把文本存入对象存储
从 Frontier 取出下一个 URL
解析页面里的新链接并加入待抓取集合
通过 DNS 解析域名到 IP
向外部网页服务器拉取 HTML
why: 先拿 URL，再解析域名并抓取 HTML；拿到页面后才抽取文本和新链接。这个朴素流程后续会被拆成更可靠的流水线。
why_en: The crawler takes a URL, resolves DNS, fetches HTML, extracts and stores text, then enqueues newly discovered links.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A[Frontier URL] --> B[DNS]
  B --> C[Fetch HTML]
  C --> D[Extract text]
  C --> E[Extract links]
  E --> A
  D --> F[S3 text]
q_en: Put the basic web crawler data flow in the correct order.

q: 高层设计里哪些组件属于核心路径？（多选）
options: Frontier Queue
Crawler
DNS
S3 文本存储
广告投放服务
why: Frontier 管待抓 URL，Crawler 拉取和解析，DNS 支持访问外部站点，S3 存文本输出。广告投放与这个离线抓取系统无关。
why_en: The basic path uses a frontier queue, crawler workers, DNS, and blob storage for text output.
options_en: Frontier queue of URLs waiting to be crawled.
The crawler that fetches and parses pages.
DNS resolution for external domains.
S3 storage for extracted text.
An ad-serving service.
q_en: Which components belong on the core high-level path? (Select all that apply)
optionExplanations: Frontier 保存待抓 URL 队列，是驱动整个抓取循环的起点。
Crawler 负责实际发请求、拉页面、解析出文本和新链接。
DNS 把域名解析成 IP，没有它 Crawler 连不上外部站点。
S3 承接抽取出的文本产出，是这条流水线的终点存储。
广告投放服务属于变现系统，跟离线抓取管线没有依赖关系。
optionExplanations_en: The frontier holds the queue of URLs waiting to crawl and drives the whole fetch loop.
The crawler issues requests, fetches pages, and parses out text and new links.
DNS resolves domain names to IPs; without it the crawler can't reach any external site.
S3 receives the extracted text output, the terminal storage of this pipeline.
Ad serving belongs to a monetization system with no dependency on this offline crawl pipeline.

scenario: 爬虫要保存海量网页文本供后续批处理和训练读取，数据体量巨大，访问模式是对象级读写，不需要关系型事务。
q: 文本数据最适合存到哪里？
options: 存进 Redis 字符串缓存
只留在爬虫本机磁盘
对象存储（S3 / GCS 等 Blob 服务）
直接写进 Frontier 队列消息体
why: 抽取后的文本是大规模 blob 数据，适合便宜、持久、可扩展的对象存储；队列只传引用，不能承载大 payload。数据库或缓存只保元数据更合理。
why_en: Extracted text is large blob data, so object storage is the right durable and scalable target while queues should carry only references.
whenOtherWins: 如果是少量结构化查询字段，放关系型或 NoSQL 表更方便；如果是短期热点小对象，缓存可以作为读取加速层。
tradeoff: 对象存储的持久与低成本 vs 队列/缓存的即时但脆弱访问
options_en: Store it as a Redis string.
Keep it only on the crawler's local disk.
Object storage such as S3 or GCS.
Write it straight into the Frontier queue message.
q_en: Where should the extracted text data be stored?
scenario_en: The crawler must store massive extracted text for later batch processing and training reads; access is object-level and does not need relational transactions.
optionExplanations: Redis 更适合毫秒级热点小对象缓存，海量长期文本会把内存成本推得很高。
本机磁盘只在单机、可丢弃场景下够用，Worker 重建或迁移时数据就没了。
文本体量大、访问是对象级读写、不需要事务，这正是对象存储该出场的场景。
队列消息应保持轻量用于调度，大 payload 会拖慢投递和消费。
optionExplanations_en: Redis fits millisecond hot-object caching, but holding massive long-lived text there gets expensive fast.
Local disk only works for single-machine disposable data — it's gone when a worker is rebuilt or moved.
Large text volume, object-level access, and no transaction needs is exactly when object storage fits.
Queue messages should stay lightweight for scheduling; a large payload slows delivery down.

q: 面试中追问种子 URL 的来源，主要体现了什么设计意识？
options: 它能让 DNS 缓存完全失效
它把文本抽取改成实时查询问题
它证明不需要 Frontier Queue
它明确系统启动边界，避免默认全网可达
why: 几乎所有爬虫都从有限种子集合启动，且不可能覆盖全网。问清楚种子来源是在确认系统输入，而不是假设能自动发现所有页面。
why_en: Clarifying seed URLs defines the system's starting boundary and avoids pretending the crawler can discover the entire web from nothing.
options_en: It makes DNS caching completely ineffective.
It turns text extraction into a real-time query problem.
It proves the Frontier Queue is unnecessary.
It clarifies the system's starting boundary instead of assuming full web reachability.
q_en: What design awareness does asking about seed URL sources show?
optionExplanations: 种子 URL 来源和 DNS 缓存命中率没有因果关系。
文本抽取是抓到页面之后的离线处理，不会因为问种子来源就变成实时查询。
Frontier 依然要保存待抓 URL，问种子来源不影响它是否存在。
问清种子来自哪里，是在确认系统从哪个有限集合起步，而非假设能发现全网。
optionExplanations_en: Seed URL provenance has no causal link to DNS cache hit rate.
Text extraction is offline processing after a fetch; asking about seeds doesn't make it real-time.
The frontier still holds pending URLs regardless of where the seeds came from.
Asking where seeds come from confirms the crawler starts from a finite set, not an assumed full web.

scenario: 单个 Crawler 同时负责 DNS、抓 HTML、抽文本、抽链接；任何一步失败都会让整条 URL 处理进度变得不清晰。
q: 提升容错性的首要改造是什么？
options: 拆成 Fetcher、Extraction 两阶段流水线
只增加更多线程数量，但不改变任务边界划分
把原始 HTML 完整内容直接放进队列消息体里
把所有处理步骤都塞进一个更大的单体进程里
why: 流水线把失败隔离在单个阶段，可以重试抓取或解析而不重做其他工作，也能按瓶颈独立扩缩容。它是数据处理题常见的第一层可靠性改造。
why_en: Splitting the crawler into pipeline stages isolates failures, enables stage-level retries, and lets each stage scale independently.
whenOtherWins: 如果流量极小且失败代价低，一个简单单进程实现足够；但 10B 页面和 5 天期限下，阶段边界更重要。
tradeoff: 阶段隔离便于重试和独立扩容 vs 单体实现更简单
options_en: Split into Fetcher and Extraction pipeline stages.
Just add more worker threads without changing any task boundaries.
Put the entire raw HTML content directly inside the queue message.
Cram every processing step into one larger monolithic process.
q_en: What is the first change to improve fault tolerance?
scenario_en: One crawler process handles DNS, HTML fetch, text extraction, and link extraction; if any step fails, the URL's progress becomes ambiguous.
optionExplanations: 把网络抓取和 HTML 解析拆成两阶段，失败互不牵连，各自能独立重试扩容。
只加线程不改变任务边界，一步失败还是会搞乱整条 URL 的处理状态。
把原始 HTML 塞进消息体是加大 payload，队列更不稳定，不是容错改造。
塞进一个更大单体只会让失败面更集中，跟目标方向正好相反。
optionExplanations_en: Splitting fetch and extraction into stages isolates failures so each can retry and scale on its own.
Adding threads without changing task boundaries still lets one failing step wreck the whole URL's state.
Cramming raw HTML into the message just grows the payload and destabilizes the queue further.
Cramming everything into one bigger monolith concentrates the failure surface, the opposite of the goal.

q: URL Fetcher 和 Text/URL Extraction 的关键职责区别是什么？
options: Fetcher 负责解析链接，Extraction 负责访问 DNS
Fetcher 存原始 HTML，Extraction 从中产出文本和新 URL
Fetcher 负责更新模型参数，Extraction 负责训练模型
Fetcher 负责做去重，Extraction 负责管队列可见性
why: Fetcher 处理最容易失败的网络抓取并保存原始 HTML；Extraction 处理已经落库的 HTML，输出文本和链接。这个边界让抓取和解析可以分别重试。
why_en: The fetcher retrieves and stores raw HTML, while extraction workers read that HTML to produce text and discovered URLs.
tradeoff: 抓取失败隔离 vs 解析失败隔离——两个阶段各自的重试边界
options_en: The fetcher is responsible for parsing links, while extraction is responsible for talking to DNS.
The fetcher stores raw HTML; extraction turns it into text and new URLs.
The fetcher is responsible for updating model weights, while extraction is responsible for training the model.
The fetcher is responsible for deduplicating, while extraction is responsible for managing queue visibility.
q_en: What is the key responsibility split between the URL Fetcher and Text/URL Extraction?
optionExplanations: Fetcher 不解析链接，DNS 查询发生在抓取之前，不是 Extraction 的职责。
Fetcher 存原始 HTML，Extraction 读 HTML 产出文本和新链接。
模型训练不在这个爬虫流水线里，两个阶段都不碰模型参数。
去重和队列可见性是 Metadata DB 和队列服务的职责，不是这两阶段的划分依据。
optionExplanations_en: The fetcher doesn't parse links; DNS lookups happen before fetching, not inside extraction.
Fetcher stores raw HTML; extraction reads it to produce text and new URLs.
Model training isn't part of this pipeline; neither stage touches model weights.
Dedup and queue visibility belong to the metadata store and queue service, not this stage split.

scenario: 队列需要传递待处理 URL，但每个 URL 还要记录抓取状态、HTML 对象地址、文本对象地址、失败次数和深度等元数据。
q: Web Crawler 应该新增什么组件承载这些 URL 状态？
options: 让每个 Worker 用本地文件记录状态
只依赖浏览器缓存
Metadata DB，队列消息只放 URL 记录 id
把完整 HTML 和状态都塞进 SQS 消息
why: Metadata DB 保存可查询、可更新的 URL 状态和对象存储引用；队列负责调度，不适合大 payload 或复杂状态。DynamoDB、Postgres、MySQL 都可讨论。
why_en: A metadata database should hold URL state and blob references while the queue carries only lightweight identifiers for scheduling.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是临时小任务且不需要恢复，消息体可以带完整上下文；这里的规模和容错要求需要持久元数据。
diagram:
flowchart LR
Seeds[Seed URLs] --> Frontier[URL Frontier]
Frontier --> State[(URL state DB)]
Frontier --> Queue[Fetch queue]
Queue --> Fetcher[Fetcher workers]
tradeoff: 持久可查询的元数据存储 vs 把状态硬塞进队列消息
options_en: Have each worker keep state in a local file.
Rely only on the browser cache.
A Metadata DB, with the queue message carrying only the URL record id.
Stuff the full HTML and all state into the SQS message.
q_en: What component should the web crawler add to hold URL state?
scenario_en: The queue needs to pass URLs to process, but each URL also needs metadata such as crawl status, HTML object location, text object location, failure count, and depth.
optionExplanations: 本地文件只有那台机器能看到，别的 Worker 查不到某个 URL 的最新状态。
浏览器缓存服务的是终端用户，这条抓取管线里没有浏览器会话。
状态和大对象引用放进可查询的数据库，队列只传一个轻量 id 做调度。
把完整 HTML 塞进消息体会让队列超载，也让状态和调度耦合在一起。
optionExplanations_en: A local file is visible only to that one machine; other workers can't see a URL's current state.
Browser caching serves end users; there's no browser session in this crawl pipeline.
State and blob references live in a queryable database while the queue carries just a lightweight id.
Stuffing full HTML into the message overloads the queue and couples state with scheduling.

q: 为什么不应该把原始 HTML 直接放进 Frontier 或处理队列消息里？
options: 这样做会让 DNS 解析明显变慢
这样做会导致 robots.txt 无法被正确解析
队列消息根本不允许携带任何字符串
队列不适合大 payload，应传对象存储引用而非内容本身
why: 队列适合传小消息和调度信号，不适合承载大量 HTML 内容。把 HTML 放对象存储、在消息里传 metadata id 或 URL 引用更稳。

why: DelaySeconds 只影响新发送的消息；已经被取出的消息要用 ChangeMessageVisibility 延长不可见时间。这样不会忙等，也不会违反 Crawl-delay。
why_en: For an in-flight SQS message, ChangeMessageVisibility is the right way to defer retry until the crawl delay has elapsed.
whenOtherWins: 如果是在首次发送新消息时要延迟投递，DelaySeconds 才合适；如果 URL 被 Disallow，则应确认并跳过。
tradeoff: 延后已取出消息的可见性 vs 只对新消息生效的 DelaySeconds
options_en: Fetch immediately since the robots.txt rule already allows it.
Try calling the DelaySeconds parameter to change this message's delivery timing.
Call ChangeMessageVisibility to defer when it becomes visible again.
Delete the message outright and permanently drop the URL.

termDefinitions.meaning: 仅对新发送到队列的消息生效的延迟投递参数。

q_en: How should an already in-flight SQS message be handled?
scenario_en: A worker receives a URL from the queue; robots.txt allows it, but the domain's last crawl time is still inside the Crawl-delay window.
optionExplanations: robots 允许只是第一道门，还没过 Crawl-delay 这道节奏检查，不能立刻抓。
DelaySeconds 这个参数只延迟全新发送的消息，跟已经取出的这条无关。

URL 只是暂时还没到抓取时间，删掉消息等于永久放弃这条本该正常抓的页面。
optionExplanations_en: Robots.txt allowing it is only step one — the crawl-delay pacing check still hasn't passed.
DelaySeconds only applies to a message not yet sent; this one has already been received.
Since the message is already in flight, hiding it longer needs a visibility change call, not a new delay.

scenario: 系统需要判断每个域名上次抓取时间、已解析的 robots 规则，并在多个 Worker 之间共享这些信息。

完全依赖 DNS TTL
在 Metadata DB 中维护 Domain 表

why_en: A shared domain table keeps robots rules and last-crawl timestamps visible to all workers for coordinated politeness checks.
whenOtherWins: 如果只有一个 Worker 或只是本地 demo，本地状态可以简化；分布式爬虫需要共享状态。
tradeoff: 集中共享状态 vs 每个 Worker 各自本地状态
options_en: Have each worker keep its own local map.
Encode the last crawl time into the HTML filename.
Rely entirely on DNS TTL.
Maintain a Domain table inside the Metadata DB.
q_en: What is the best way to model shared domain state?
scenario_en: The system must track each domain's last crawl time and parsed robots rules, and share that information across multiple workers.
optionExplanations: 本地 Map 只活在一个进程里，别的 Worker 完全看不到这个域名刚被抓过。
文件名不是可查询的结构化字段，没法方便地按域名读取或更新时间戳。
DNS TTL 管的是域名解析结果的有效期，跟抓取节奏或 robots 规则无关。
Domain 表集中存 robots 规则和上次抓取时间，所有 Worker 读到同一份状态。
optionExplanations_en: A local map lives in one process; other workers have no visibility into a domain's recent crawl.
A filename isn't a queryable structured field, so reading or updating a timestamp per domain is awkward.
DNS TTL governs how long a resolved IP stays valid, unrelated to crawl pacing or robots rules.
A shared domain table centralizes robots rules and last-crawl time so every worker reads the same state.

scenario: 多个 Worker 可能同时拿到同一域名的 URL，为避免同时抓取，需要在抓取前抢一个短期域名锁。
q: 下面哪种 Redis 命令形态最贴合这个需求？
options: 获得锁：key 不存在才设置，10 秒后自动过期
永久删除该域名的所有待抓 URL
把该域名塞进 Bloom Filter
把这条消息立刻发进 DLQ
why: SET NX EX 可以原子地获取短期锁，TTL 可对齐 Crawl-delay，防止 Worker 崩溃后锁永久存在。抢不到锁的 Worker 应延后消息可见性。
why_en: Redis SET with NX and EX provides an atomic per-domain lease that expires automatically after the crawl-delay window.
whenOtherWins: 如果只需统计每秒请求数，滑动窗口计数更合适；如果需要强事务和审计，数据库锁可能更合适但成本更高。
tradeoff: 原子短租锁保证互斥 vs 长期删除/标记类操作
options_en: Acquire the lock: set only if the key is absent, auto-expiring after 10 seconds.
Permanently delete every pending URL for that domain.
Add the domain into a Bloom filter.
Send the message straight to the DLQ.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis SET 的选项，只在 key 不存在时才写入。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NX is a Redis SET option that writes the key only if it does not already exist.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis SET 的选项，给 key 设置秒级过期时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: EX is a Redis SET option that attaches an expiration time in seconds to the key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 概率型集合结构，可能有假阳性但不会有假阴性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Bloom filter is a probabilistic set structure that can have false positives but never false negatives.

q_en: Which Redis command shape best fits this locking need?
scenario_en: Multiple workers may receive URLs from the same domain at the same time, so each worker must acquire a short-lived domain lock before fetching.
optionExplanations: NX 保证只有第一个 Worker 能设置成功，EX 让锁在崩溃场景下也能自动到期，不会永久卡死。
SET 命令不会删除数据，这是新建 key，不是删除操作。
Bloom Filter 是用来判断某个东西见没见过，不能用来做互斥锁。
抢锁和消息该不该进死信队列是两件事，锁本身不会触发 DLQ。
optionExplanations_en: NX makes only the first worker succeed, and EX makes the lock lapse on its own after a crash, never stuck forever.
SET doesn't delete data — this call creates a key, it isn't a delete operation.
A Bloom filter checks whether something was seen before; it can't provide mutual exclusion like a lock.
Acquiring a lock and dead-lettering a message are unrelated; the lock itself never triggers a DLQ.

q: Web Crawler 常用的默认礼貌限速大致是多少？
options: 全系统每秒 1 个请求
每个域名每秒 1 个请求
每个域名每秒 1000 个请求
每个 Worker 每天 1 个请求
why: 礼貌限速按域名维度控制，常见默认是每个域名约 1 rps。全系统仍可通过同时抓取大量不同域名取得高吞吐。
why_en: The crawler limits each domain to about one request per second while achieving aggregate throughput across many domains.
options_en: About one request per second, system-wide.
About one request per second, per domain.
About one thousand requests per second, per domain.
About one request per day, per worker.
scenario: 多个爬虫实例同时抓取同一批域名，需要一个默认的、不必特别设计就能遵守的礼貌限速基线。
q_en: What is a common default polite crawl rate for a web crawler?
scenario_en: Multiple crawler instances fetch from the same set of domains and need a default polite rate limit that is easy to enforce.
optionExplanations: 限速维度按域名算，不是把全系统压到 1 rps，那样吞吐太低。
这是常见的默认礼貌基线：每个域名约 1 rps，不用特别设计就能遵守。
1000 rps 对单个域名来说太激进，容易被识别为攻击式流量。
每天 1 次太保守，10B 页面 5 天内根本抓不完。
optionExplanations_en: The limit is scoped per domain, not the whole system throttled to one rps — that would tank throughput.
This is the common default politeness baseline: about one rps per domain, easy to enforce without special design.
1000 rps against a single domain is way too aggressive and reads like attack traffic.
Once a day per worker is far too conservative to fetch 10 billion pages in five days.

scenario: 多个爬虫实例要共同遵守每个域名每秒最多 1 个请求的规则，不能只靠单机内存计数。
q: 更合适的限流实现是？
options: 把所有 URL 按字母排序
只依赖 S3 的吞吐限制
Redis 等中心化存储里的按域名滑动窗口计数
每个 Worker 自己 sleep 1 秒
why: 分布式 Worker 需要共享限流状态，Redis 滑动窗口能按域名统计当前窗口请求数。单机 sleep 看不到其他 Worker 的请求。
why_en: A shared Redis sliding window lets distributed crawlers enforce per-domain request limits consistently.
whenOtherWins: 如果只有单实例爬虫，本地令牌桶就足够；如果域名量非常大，还要考虑限流 key 的分片和过期策略。
diagram:
flowchart TD
URL[URL] --> Domain[Extract domain]
Domain --> Token[Domain token bucket]
Token -->|allowed| Fetch[Fetch now]

tradeoff: 共享的分布式限流状态 vs 单机本地计时
options_en: Sort all URLs alphabetically.
Rely only on S3's throughput limits.
A centralized per-domain sliding-window counter, such as in Redis.
Have each worker just sleep for one second.
q_en: What rate-limiting implementation fits this distributed crawler?
scenario_en: Multiple crawler instances must jointly enforce at most one request per second per domain, so a single worker's memory counter is not enough.
optionExplanations: 字母排序和限速完全无关，也不解决跨 Worker 协调的问题。
S3 的吞吐限制管的是对象存储，不是外部网站的请求速率。
滑动窗口计数存在共享存储里，所有 Worker 读写同一份状态，能真正协调限速。
各 Worker 各睡各的，互相看不到对方的请求，聚合起来照样可能超过限速。
optionExplanations_en: Alphabetical sorting has nothing to do with rate limiting or cross-worker coordination.
S3's throughput limits govern object storage, not the request rate against external websites.
A sliding-window counter in shared storage lets every worker read and write the same state, coordinating for real.
Each worker sleeping on its own can't see the others' requests, so the combined rate can still exceed the limit.

q: 限流窗口重置时多个 Worker 同时重试，最容易产生什么问题？
options: 所有 URL 都会被自动去重
DNS 缓存会立刻全部命中
S3 里的对象会被自动删除
同步重试挤爆同一个域名配额，反复失败
why: 如果 Worker 都在同一时刻醒来，它们会再次拥挤到同一个域名窗口。加随机 jitter 能把重试打散，减少同步冲突。
why_en: Jitter spreads retry attempts over time so workers do not stampede the same per-domain rate-limit window.
options_en: All URLs get automatically deduplicated.
DNS caches suddenly hit one hundred percent.
Objects in S3 get automatically deleted.
Synchronized retries flood the same domain quota and keep failing together.
q_en: What problem happens when many workers retry at the same rate-limit window reset?
optionExplanations: 去重逻辑跟窗口重置时机无关，不会因为重试同步就触发。
DNS 缓存命中率和限流窗口重置是两个独立的机制。
S3 对象生命周期由存储策略管，不会因为重试撞车就被删除。
大家同一时刻醒来，会挤爆同一个域名的配额，结果又一起失败。
optionExplanations_en: Dedup logic is unrelated to when the rate-limit window resets — synchronized retries don't trigger it.
DNS cache hit rate and rate-limit window resets are two independent mechanisms.
S3 object deletion follows storage policy, not a pile-up of retries.
Everyone waking up at once floods the same domain's quota, so they fail together again.

q: 这组 BOE 带宽推算得到的结论是什么？
options: 单机网络理论上限约 12,500 页/秒，只是理论峰值
单机实际就能稳定跑到约 12,500 页/秒
带宽和页面大小对估算机器数量没有意义
这个数字说明应该改成抓更小的页面
why: 200 Gbps 换算成约 12,500 页/秒只是纯网络理论上限；DNS、限流、重试等现实损耗会让实际吞吐明显更低。
why_en: The bandwidth math gives a theoretical per-machine ceiling of about twelve thousand five hundred pages per second, but real throughput will be far lower once you account for DNS, rate limits, and retries.
scenario: 网络优化型实例带宽约 200 Gbps，平均页面体量约 2MB，这决定了单机纯网络维度的理论抓取速度上限。
options_en: The theoretical per-machine ceiling is about 12,500 pages/sec, only a theoretical peak.
A single machine can actually sustain 12,500 pages per second in practice.
Bandwidth and page size are irrelevant to estimating fleet size.
This number implies you should switch to crawling smaller pages.
q_en: What conclusion does this back-of-the-envelope bandwidth estimate give?
scenario_en: A network-optimized instance has about 200 Gbps of bandwidth, and the average page transfer is about 2 MB, which sets the per-machine theoretical network ceiling.
optionExplanations: 200 Gbps 除以 2MB/页只是纯网络算术给出的峰值，不代表真实可持续吞吐。
实际吞吐会被 DNS、限流、重试等损耗拉低，达不到这个理论峰值。
带宽和页面大小正是算机器数的两个直接输入，不是无关变量。
这个数字是用来估算需要多少机器，不是在建议改抓取内容策略。
optionExplanations_en: 200 Gbps divided by 2MB per page is pure network arithmetic — a ceiling, not a sustainable number.
Real throughput gets pulled down by DNS, rate limits, and retries, so it never sustains that peak.
Bandwidth and page size are exactly the two direct inputs to sizing the fleet, not irrelevant variables.
This number is meant to size the fleet, not to suggest changing what pages get crawled.

q: 把这个 30% 折扣系数放进估算的目的是什么？
options: 把所需机器数直接提高到原来的 3 倍
把理论峰值折算成更贴近现实的吞吐去估算机器数
证明可以完全忽略 DNS 和限流这些因素
说明只需要原计划 30% 的机器成本

why_en: The thirty-percent utilization factor discounts the theoretical peak down to a realistic sustainable throughput that is actually used to size the fleet.

options_en: It directly triples the number of machines required.
It discounts the theoretical peak into a realistic throughput used to size the fleet.
It proves DNS and rate limiting can be fully ignored.
It means the project only needs 30% of the original machine budget.

scenario_en: Using the same back-of-the-envelope assumptions, real losses from DNS, latency, rate limits, and retries mean only about 30% of bandwidth is effectively usable.
optionExplanations: 30% 是利用率折扣，不是机器数的倍数，两者算法方向不一样。
拿理论峰值乘以 30% 利用率，得到更接近真实运行情况的吞吐，再拿它算机器数。
正因为 DNS、限流这些损耗真实存在，才需要打这个折扣，不是可以忽略它们。
30% 折的是吞吐，不是机器预算或成本，两者不能画等号。
optionExplanations_en: 30% is a utilization discount, not a multiplier on machine count — the math points the other way.
Multiply the theoretical peak by 30% utilization for throughput closer to reality, then size the fleet with it.
This discount exists precisely because DNS and rate-limit losses are real, not because you can ignore them.
The 30% discounts throughput, not machine budget or cost — those aren't the same number.

q: 单机抓完 10B 页面耗时计算在设计讨论里起什么作用？
options: 说明页面大小对完成时间没有任何影响
证明应该直接放弃 5 天这个时间要求
算出单机约 31 天，需多机并行才压进 5 天预算
证明单机完全可以满足 5 天的时间要求

scenario: 把 10B 页面除以约 3,750 页/秒的单机吞吐，得到单机独立完成全部抓取所需的时间。
options_en: It shows page size has no effect on completion time.
It proves the five-day requirement should be abandoned.
It shows a single machine needs about 31 days, proving parallel machines are required to fit the five-day budget.
It proves a single machine can already meet the five-day requirement.

scenario_en: Divide 10 billion pages by the single-machine throughput of about 3,750 pages per second to estimate how long one machine would need.

31 天超预算恰恰是要论证需要并行，不是要放弃 5 天这个目标。
单机独立跑要约 31 天，远超 5 天预算，这个差距正是要并行扩容的依据。
31 天远超 5 天，单机显然满足不了这个时间要求。
optionExplanations_en: Page size is already baked into per-second throughput — it's exactly what produced this 31-day figure.
Being over budget at 31 days argues FOR parallelizing, not for abandoning the five-day goal.
One machine alone needs about 31 days, far past the five-day budget — that gap is why you scale out.
31 days is far beyond five days, so a single machine clearly can't meet the requirement.

q: 用 8 台机器线性并行估算的重点是什么？
options: 机器数量对完成时间没有任何实际影响
无论用多少台机器都无法在 5 天内完成任务
线性假设在真实系统里永远精确成立
线性并行把 31 天压到约 3.9 天，重点是估算路径

options_en: The number of machines has no effect on completion time.
No number of machines can finish within five days.
The linear assumption always holds exactly in real systems.
Linear parallelism cuts 31 days to about 3.9 days; the point is the estimation path.
q_en: What is the point of the eight-machine linear parallelism estimate?
scenario_en: Take the roughly 31-day single-machine estimate and divide it linearly by the number of parallel machines; this example uses eight machines.
optionExplanations: 机器数直接除进总耗时里，正是它把天数压下来的。
8 台机器就能把 31 天压到约 4 天内，5 天预算是够得着的。
现实里有热点域名、机器差异等因素，线性只是一阶近似，不会精确成立。
除以机器数只是粗略线性近似，面试更看重你能讲清估算路径、承认假设局限。
optionExplanations_en: Machine count divides directly into total time — it's exactly what pulls the day count down.
Eight machines already brings 31 days under roughly four, so the five-day budget is reachable.
Real systems have hot domains and uneven machines, so linear scaling is only a first-order guess.
Dividing by machine count is a rough approximation; what matters is naming the path and its limits.

q: 为什么每个域名 1 rps 的礼貌限制不等于全系统只能 1 rps？

因为 robots.txt 可以被忽略
因为 S3 会替爬虫下载网页
因为 DNS 查询不算请求

options_en: The crawler can hit millions of distinct domains at once, each rate-limited on its own.
Because robots.txt can simply be ignored.
Because S3 downloads the pages on the crawler's behalf.
Because DNS lookups do not count as requests.

optionExplanations: 限速是按域名分别计的，同时抓几百万个不同域名，总吞吐照样很高。
忽略 robots.txt 违反礼貌抓取原则，也不是吞吐能起来的原因。
S3 只存文本产出，从不替爬虫发网络请求。
DNS 查询本身也占带宽和时间，只是限速规则通常不把它计进请求配额。
optionExplanations_en: The rate limit is counted per domain, so hitting millions of domains at once still yields high throughput.
Ignoring robots.txt violates the politeness principle and isn't why throughput is high anyway.
S3 only stores the text output — it never makes network requests on the crawler's behalf.
DNS lookups do take time and bandwidth; they're just not usually counted against the request quota.

scenario: Parser Worker 只需要从对象存储读取 HTML、抽文本、写回文本，但必须跟上 URL Fetcher 的产出速度。
q: Parser Worker 更适合怎样扩缩容？

按下游队列积压动态扩缩容
固定一台机器，完全不做并发
按 DNS TTL 来扩缩容
why: 解析阶段计算和 I/O 相对简单，可以用队列积压作为伸缩信号，通过 Lambda、Fargate 或 Worker 池扩展。这样不必提前精确估算解析机器数。
why_en: Parser workers can autoscale based on the downstream queue backlog so they keep pace with fetchers without fixed capacity guesses.
whenOtherWins: 如果解析包含复杂模型推理或严格批处理窗口，可能需要专门容量规划；本题解析任务较常规。
tradeoff: 按积压信号弹性伸缩 vs 固定容量预先规划
options_en: Run it only once a day at midnight.
Autoscale based on the downstream queue backlog.
Fix it at one machine with no concurrency.
Scale it based on DNS TTL.
q_en: How should Parser Workers scale up and down?

q: 补全 URL 级去重和内容级去重的区别：

q_en: Fill in the difference between URL-level and content-level deduplication:

hash 存 Metadata DB 并建索引
只比较 URL 字符串是否完全相同

q_en: Which practical content-deduplication approach fits this crawler best?

q: Bloom Filter 在内容去重里的核心语义是什么？

说存在时一定存在，说不存在时只是可能不存在

tradeoff: 精确但重的 hash 索引 vs 省内存但有 false positive 的 Bloom Filter
options_en: It can return the original HTML content.
It can replace every database index with zero error.
Saying 'absent' is always certain; saying 'present' is only probable.
Saying 'present' is always certain; saying 'absent' is only probable.

termDefinitions.meaning: 概率型集合结构：不存在时一定准确，存在时可能是假阳性。

termDefinitions.meaning: 误判为存在，实际上并不存在。

scenario_en: The crawler must decide after fetching whether content has been seen before, so compare Bloom filters and exact hash indexes on existence-check semantics.

It can occasionally mistake something unseen for seen, so it cannot be a zero-error replacement for exact indexes.
A miss can be trusted completely as unseen, but a hit is only a probable signal worth double-checking.

q_en: What is the better pre-fetch optimization?
scenario_en: Some URLs point to very large files, and the crawler only wants pages suitable for text extraction, avoiding objects larger than 10 MB.
optionExplanations: HEAD 只要响应头不要响应体，看一眼声明的文件大小就能提前避开超大对象。
先整份下载完再判断，大文件的带宽和时间已经花掉了，探测就没了意义。
队列本来就不该扛大 payload，把整个文件塞进去只会让消息更臃肿。
关掉重试解决不了大文件问题，反而让本该成功的抓取也变得更脆弱。
optionExplanations_en: A HEAD request fetches only headers, not the body, so checking the declared file size avoids big downloads.
Downloading the whole file first already spends the bandwidth and time you were trying to save.
Queues shouldn't carry large payloads to begin with; cramming a whole file in just bloats the message.
Turning off retries doesn't solve the large-file problem; it just makes normal fetches more fragile.

scenario: 需求从一次性抓取变成每月重新抓取，且不同 URL 应按最近抓取时间、重要性或变化频率安排下次抓取。
q: 持续重新抓取时应该新增哪个组件？
options: 单机本地队列
URL Scheduler
更大的 robots.txt 文件
只读 DNS 缓存
why: URL Scheduler 根据 last crawl time、优先级或 popularity 决定何时把 URL 放回队列。持续更新和一次性 crawl 的调度问题不同。
why_en: A URL scheduler decides when to re-enqueue pages based on recency, priority, or popularity for continual crawling.
whenOtherWins: 如果需求只是一次性离线抓取，解析 Worker 直接把新 URL 入队即可，不必单独引入调度器。
diagram:
flowchart TD
URL[Candidate URL] --> Rules[Trap heuristics]
Rules --> Depth[Depth and pattern caps]
Rules --> Score[Quality score]
Score --> Frontier[Priority frontier]
tradeoff: 按时间/优先级调度重新抓取 vs 一次性抓取无需调度
options_en: A single-machine local queue.
A URL Scheduler.
A bigger robots.txt file.
A read-only DNS cache.

termDefinitions.meaning: 根据上次抓取时间、优先级或热度决定何时重新入队的组件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A URL scheduler decides when to re-enqueue a page based on recency, priority, or popularity.

q_en: What component should be added for ongoing recrawls?
scenario_en: The requirement changes from a one-time crawl to a monthly recrawl, and different URLs should be scheduled by last crawl time, importance, or change frequency.
optionExplanations: 单机队列没法记录每个域名的抓取历史和优先级，撑不起持续调度。
调度器按上次抓取时间、重要性或变化频率决定何时把 URL 放回队列，正对上这个需求。
robots.txt 只声明能不能抓，不管什么时候该重新抓。
DNS 缓存管的是域名解析，跟要不要重新抓某个页面完全无关。
optionExplanations_en: A single-machine queue can't track each domain's crawl history or priority, so it can't drive scheduling.
A scheduler re-enqueues URLs by last-crawl time, importance, or change frequency — exactly what's needed.
robots.txt only says what's allowed to fetch, not when a page is due for a refetch.
DNS caching handles domain resolution and has nothing to do with when a page should be recrawled.

scenario: 业务希望优先抓取重要域名或热门页面，但队列系统本身不提供单队列内的严格优先级消费。
q: 队列不支持严格优先级时，一个简单可解释的方案是什么？
options: 只在 Metadata DB 改字段，不改消费逻辑
禁用死信队列
多个优先级队列，Worker 先轮询高优先级
把所有 URL 随机打散
why: 多个队列或 Kafka 多 topic 可以模拟优先级，Worker 先消费高优先级再降级消费普通队列。这样不必在单队列里实现复杂排序。
why_en: Separate queues or topics per priority let crawlers poll high-priority work first without requiring sorted consumption inside one queue.
whenOtherWins: 如果队列产品原生支持优先级，可直接使用；如果所有 URL 价值接近，单队列更简单。
tradeoff: 多队列模拟优先级 vs 单队列里排序
options_en: Only change a field in the Metadata DB without changing consumption logic.
Disable the dead-letter queue.
Multiple priority queues, with workers polling the high-priority one first.
Shuffle all URLs randomly.
q_en: What simple priority scheme works when the queue lacks strict priority support?
scenario_en: The business wants to crawl important domains or popular pages first, but the queue does not support strict priority inside one queue.
optionExplanations: 光改字段不改消费逻辑，Worker 拿消息的顺序还是老样子，优先级不会真的生效。
死信队列处理的是失败消息，跟要不要优先抓某些 URL 没有关系。
把 URL 按优先级分到不同队列，Worker 先轮询高优先级队列，简单地模拟出优先消费。
随机打散跟优先级方向正好相反，重要页面反而更难被优先抓到。
optionExplanations_en: Changing a field without changing consumption logic leaves message order unchanged — priority never kicks in.
A dead-letter queue handles failed messages, unrelated to prioritizing which URLs to crawl first.
Splitting URLs into priority-specific queues and polling the high-priority one first simulates priority.
Random shuffling is the opposite of prioritization — important pages get harder to reach first.

q: 把「可恢复且礼貌的爬虫」核心决策链排成正确顺序。
steps: 用 SQS visibility timeout、ChangeMessageVisibility 和 DLQ 管理重试与失败隔离
在 Metadata DB 中保存 URL/Domain 状态和对象存储引用
先承认单体 Crawler 任一步失败都会让进度难以恢复
用 robots 规则、每域名锁和共享限流保证礼貌抓取
把抓取与解析拆成流水线阶段，队列消息只传记录 id
why: 先识别单体失败面，再拆流水线并持久化状态；有了队列语义后才能可靠重试，最后叠加 robots 和限流保证对外部站点友好。
why_en: The robust design starts by isolating pipeline stages, persists metadata, uses SQS retry semantics, and then layers in robots-aware politeness controls.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A[Single crawler failure risk] --> B[Pipeline stages]
  B --> C[Metadata DB references]
  C --> D[SQS retry and DLQ]
  D --> E[Robots and rate limits]
q_en: Put the core decision chain for a recoverable and polite crawler in the correct order.
